**Finding: missing** (INSURANCE — Vendor insurance, severity low)

The Agreement contains no insurance provision at all — a text search for "insurance" returns zero hits, and Section 20 (General Matters) runs (a)–(i) covering time, notices, waiver, assignment, independent contractor, force majeure, severability, governing law and headings, then ends.

Insurance is expected for this vendor:
- **Section 4** — Garman installs the Software on our AS400s at each Authorized Location and performs conversion of Sparkling's data.
- **Section 9** — Garman personnel work on implementation alongside our project manager.

That is a vendor both attending our premises and processing our data, which is squarely the playbook's walk-away scenario when uninsured.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** new Section 20(j) inserted after p0147 with the preferred package — CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber liability USD 5M where our data is processed, workers' compensation as required by law, and certificates on request, maintained through the term and one year after. The comment flags the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) in case Garman's actual coverage limits are lower.
